gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Bruno Ace SC spreads its open-mouthed letters out like beads on a long thread, with no thinning anywhere. Tsukimi Rounded keeps its parallel-edged curves quiet beneath.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-tuffy: Wide, beaded, unmistakably loud. Bruno Ace SC spaces its letters out in a display voice, while Tuffy, a plain sans, draws everything like a pencil that never presses harder.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-urbanist: Urbanist reads like a rolling-ball pen, one trail of line that never curls shut on itself. Bruno Ace SC adds a stretched, beaded display voice, and the two keep their openness in common.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-varela: Varela is friendly and modern, its t built with crossbar and stem at one width and its c like a wide mouth. And Bruno Ace SC is the showy one, spreading its letters out like beads while Varela just gets on with reading.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-varela-round: Bruno Ace SC stretches its open-aperture letters along like beads on a thread, with no calligraphic thinning anywhere. Varela Round settles in beside it as sans-serif, its wide-mouthed rounds feeling modern, soft and clean next to that display swagger.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-varta: Every line in Bruno Ace SC looks traced with a single marker tip, then strung out wide with open apertures. Varta, a plain sans, quietly gives each e and a a big open eye.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-vazirmatn: Vazirmatn reads approachable and modern, its wide-open s never tightening, while Bruno Ace SC bends wire-like lines across every word. A long page would stay easy and relaxed.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-wix-madefor-displ: Spaced out, wiry and bold. Bruno Ace SC is built for display and never lets a hairline appear, whereas Wix Madefor Display, a sans-serif, does its best work in quiet, gently flared curve ends that stay apart.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-wix-madefor-text: Expressive is the right word for Bruno Ace SC, which keeps one constant pen width across beaded, widely spaced letters. Wix Madefor Text, a sans, answers with open terminals that stay professional and easy to follow.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-ysabeau: Approachable describes Ysabeau best, with sweeping curves that never close up, while Bruno Ace SC adds thin joins that are no thinner than its stems. Ysabeau, a plain sans, would carry a long passage with an easy, open flow.
